abilities.name: As Water Seeks Equilibrium
abilities.caveat: Typing 'C' shows the short Charged Attack; holding to charge enters Equitable Judgment, the empowered channeled attack — not modeled, since it feeds on Sourcewater Droplets picked up from the field. Each Droplet he absorbs also restores 16% of his Max HP.
_curatorNotes: Droplet-absorption self-heal (16% MaxHP per Droplet consumed, gcsim charge.go:301-312 consumeDroplet) named in the caveat 2026-07-28 (capability sweep). Not authorable: absorption count is player-dependent field state inside the unmodeled EJ system; a bare heal effect would fake its trigger cadence. The wiki's C4 'heal' credit is this same base mechanic — C4 only spawns a Droplet (cons.go:46-79, 4s ICD), stub-with-caveat stands.

Normals: 3-hit catalyst chain. attackHitmarks=[19,16,32], attackFrames built via InitNormalCancelSlice(hitmark, animLen). N1 explicit overrides ActionAttack=29 ActionCharge=20; N2 ActionAttack=31 ActionCharge=22; N3 ActionWalk=61 ActionCharge=51. N3 final-hit C key omitted per convention.

Charge (short CA): chargeFrames=InitAbilSlice(87) with ActionCharge=69 (omit C self-cancel), ActionSkill=26→E, ActionBurst=27→Q, ActionDash=25→D, ActionJump=26→J, ActionSwap=58→swap, ActionAttack default=87→N. Short-CA gate: only fires if early-cancelled before Seal of Arbitration forms (~209f initial Legal Eval setup).

Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment NOT authored: requires Sourcewater Droplet pickup state (deferred — 'collectibles on the field' has no schema primitive), and the multi-tick channeled mechanic doesn't fit chargeFrames (single FrameMap). Per-tick FlatDmg = chargeJudgement[lvl=10] × MaxHP = 14.47% MaxHP Hydro per tick; first tick 6f after EJ start, ticks at 22f then 25f intervals; total dur 173f after legalEval (which can be reduced by 0/57/111/209f by absorbing 0/1/2/3 droplets at start). C6 extends duration by 60f per droplet absorbed during EJ.
Plunge frames not authored — Neuvillette has no custom plunge.go in gcsim source; not a meaningful rotation action.
[A7] Equitable Judgment is Neuvillette's main-DPS mode.
[A7] EJ is a multi-tick channeled action; unmodeled because there is no primitive for Sourcewater Droplet pickups (field collectibles) and the multi-tick channel does not fit a single FrameMap.

sections.title: Normal Attack
sections.description:
With light flourishes, Neuvillette commands the tides to unleash a maximum of 3 attacks, dealing Hydro DMG.
Charged Attack Empowerment: Legal Evaluation
While charging up, Neuvillette will gather the power of water, forming it into a Seal of Arbitration. In this state, Neuvillette can move and change facing, and also absorb any Sourcewater Droplets in a certain AoE.
Every Droplet he absorbs will increase the formation speed of the Seal, and will heal Neuvillette.
When the charging is stopped, if the Symbol has yet to be formed, then a Charged Attack will be unleashed. If it has been formed, then a Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment will be unleashed.

sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description:
Consumes a fixed amount of Stamina to attack opponents with a rupturing blast of water, dealing AoE Hydro DMG.
Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment
Unleashes surging torrents, dealing continuous AoE Hydro DMG to all opponents in a straight-line area in front of him.
Equitable Judgment will not consume any Stamina and lasts 3s.
If Neuvillette's HP is above 50%, he will continuously lose HP while using this attack.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description: Gathering the might of Hydro, Neuvillette plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in his path. Deals AoE Hydro DMG upon impact with the ground.

passives.name: Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority
_curatorNotes: 2026-05-14 (Cluster C Item 2): authored via the new cross-character onReaction dispatch + rotation-wide stack accrual. Each qualifying reaction (9 types: Vaporize, Frozen, ElectroCharged, LunarCharged, Bloom, LunarBloom, HydroSwirl, HydroCrystallize, LunarCrystallize) emitted by ANY team member adds 1 stack of pastDraconicGlories (max 3, 30s per-instance lifetime). Per-tier chargeDmgBonus buffs (×1.1/×1.25/×1.6 → +10/+25/+60) gated on exact stack count, anchored to Neuvillette skill casts so they render as 30s buff bars on the team buffs row.

Simplification: the in-game mechanic is per-reaction-type accrual (each reaction TYPE contributes 1 stack with its own independent 30s timer). The naive event-counting authoring over-grants when the same reaction type re-fires within 30s, but the `max: 3` cap + oldest-dropped saturation keeps the total tier from exceeding 3. In canonical teams with diverse reactions (taser-shape, freeze-shape, vape-shape) the per-type vs per-event distinction is rarely load-bearing; an over-render risk exists in mono-reaction comps where 4+ events of the same type within 30s would falsely push the tier-3 buff longer than the in-game window allows.

Buff anchor choice: trigger.onCast skill (not passive) so the per-tier buff actually renders on the timeline. Trade-off: rotations without any Neuvillette E cast won't visualize the buff. Most Neuvillette rotations include periodic Hydro application via E (or burst → Hydro infused CA loop), so this anchor covers the canonical case. If a future rotation skips E entirely the buff is silently invisible — acceptable v1 visualization gap.
passives.description:
When a party member triggers a Vaporize, Frozen, Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Bloom, Lunar-Bloom, Hydro Swirl, Hydro Crystallize or a Lunar-Crystallize reaction on opponents, 1 stack of Past Draconic Glories will be granted to Neuvillette for 30s. Max 3 stacks. Past Draconic Glories causes Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment to deal 110%/125%/160% of its original DMG.
The stacks of Past Draconic Glories created by each kind of Elemental Reaction exist independently.

passives.name: Discipline of the Supreme Arbitration

value.description: +0.6% per 1% HP above 30% Max HP, cap 30%

_curatorNotes: 2026-08-15: unknown-value `description` shortened from 109 chars to 41. Same defect class as Prune's Tolling Synchronicity, found in the same sweep — the field is a display label rendered verbatim in the tooltip's value slot, not prose. Facts are unchanged: 0.6% Hydro DMG Bonus per 1% of current HP above the 30%-of-Max-HP threshold, capping at +30% (reached at 80% HP).

HP%→Hydro DMG: 0.6% per 1% current HP above 30%, capped at +30%. updateA4() in asc.go runs on every heal/drain event; a4Buff applied as attributes.HydroP modifier. Authored as a permanent-bonus passive buff with unknown value (HP-dynamic). Renders as a chip on TeamBonusesBlock; tooltip explains the scaling.
passives.description: For each 1% of Neuvillette's current HP greater than 30% of Max HP, he will gain 0.6% Hydro DMG Bonus. A maximum bonus of 30% can be obtained this way.

constellations.name: Venerable Institution
constellations.caveat: Both effects act on Equitable Judgment, which is not modeled — the bonus Past Draconic Glories stack only feeds its damage tiers, and the interrupt resistance has nothing to show on the timeline.
_curatorNotes: Stub-with-caveat (decided 2026-05-17, EJ-gated category): downstream of the Equitable Judgment modelling gap. Per the curation philosophy, building the gadget-collectible primitive for Sourcewater Droplets + multi-tick channeled CA is high-cost and EJ-gated constellations would still be cosmetic in canonical Neuvillette rotations (the player CAs regardless). The stub IS the final state.
constellations.description:
When Neuvillette takes the field, he will obtain 1 stack of Past Draconic Glories from the Ascension Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority."
Additionally, his interruption resistance will be increased while using the Charged Attack Empowerment: Legal Evaluation and the Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment.

constellations.caveat: The Past Draconic Glories CRIT DMG bonus (+14% per stack, up to +42%) applies only to Equitable Judgment, which is not modeled, so it has no effect on the timeline.
_curatorNotes: Stub-with-caveat (decided 2026-05-17, EJ-gated category): downstream of the Equitable Judgment modelling gap, plus a second primitive gap (ability-scoped CRIT-DMG modifier — Crit modifiers currently only support character-wide scope). Cost/value firmly favors stub. The stub IS the final state.
constellations.description:
The Ascension Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority" will be enhanced: Each stack of Past Draconic Glories will increase the CRIT DMG of Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment by 14%. The maximum increase that can be achieved this way is 42%.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority."

[A7] C6's added Hydro currents during Equitable Judgment deal 10% of Max HP as Hydro DMG every 2s (per constellation description).
constellations.description:
When using Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment, Neuvillette can absorb nearby Sourcewater Droplets in an AoE. Each absorbed Droplet will increase the duration of Charged Attack: Equitable Judgment by 1s.
Additionally, when Equitable Judgment hits opponents, it will fire off 2 additional currents every 2s, each of which will deal 10% of Neuvillette's Max HP as Hydro DMG. DMG dealt this way will count as DMG dealt by Equitable Judgment.
